result.description: A fictional desktop LED lamp designed for illustration desks, hobby workbenches, and late-night reading corners. The Nordic Quill Studio Lamp combines a weighted base, stepless dimming, and a flexible dual-joint arm to provide focused warm-to-cool task lighting without taking up much space. It uses a 24W integrated LED array with three color temperature modes, a touch control strip, and a USB-C auxiliary power port for small accessories.
